entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello Alex. I... I need to make a return. I ordered a helmet, and it just isn't what I expected. I'm just so disappointed.

I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely help you with the return process. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference?

It's the color. It looked so different on the website. I feel awful about it. I've been a loyal customer for so long and I saved up for this... I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to be perfect.
I completely understand how disappointing that can be when the color isn't quite right. Let's get this sorted out for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-98765. I promise the box is unopened. I knew right away it wasn't right, so I didn't even touch it.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like you received it just eight days ago. Since our helmets fall under our standard 90-day return policy, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh, thank goodness. So you can really help me?

Absolutely. Your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities. I'm generating a pre-paid return shipping label for you right now, and it should be in your email inbox within the next five minutes. Just attach that to the original packaging and drop it off.
Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. You've really made my day. I was so worried.
You're very welcome! I'm happy I could get this resolved for you. Once we receive the helmet, you'll see the refund processed in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
